picks.file: Magnifica illa civitas Verona ; Colonia augusta Verona nova gallieniana - btv1b53178837t (1 of 2).jpg
picks.what: View of the town, engraving in Braun and Hogenberg, Civitates Orbis Terrarum, vol. 3 (colored copy, BnF)
picks.why: colored general view of the walled city and its hills; upper view of the plate, plan below cut; dated by plate (vol. 3), not the 1645 sheet

picks.file: Caspar van Wittel Veduta di Verona.jpg
picks.what: The Adige at San Giorgio in Braida, painting
picks.why: high-resolution color view; San Giorgio’s dome and Castel San Pietro clear; signature read as 1710 or 1719, hence ‘1710s’

picks.file: William Marlow (1740-1813) - View of Verona (after Bernardo Bellotto) - P.1947.LF.241 - Courtauld Gallery.jpg
picks.what: The Adige from the Ponte Nuovo, painting after Bernardo Bellotto (Courtauld Gallery)
picks.why: general view with Castel San Pietro and the Sant’Anastasia bell tower; a copy of Bellotto’s 1740s composition, 1200 px wide

picks.what: The Arena and the city, photochrom print (Library of Congress)
picks.why: Arena in front of the rooftops and hills, Torre dei Lamberti at left; says ‘Verona’ at once

picks.what: The Adige and the old town from Castel San Pietro, photograph
picks.why: recent sharp panorama; river bend, Sant’Anastasia and Torre dei Lamberti

gaps: P0: nothing (#1 is an 18th-century Van Kessel drawing; ‘1410’ is a shelfmark). P5: only an amateur 1935 watercolor of Castel San Pietro.
notes: #3, #5, #6, #7 are ‘Verona nunc Bonna’, i.e. Bonn — excluded. P2 alternative: #12 Bellotto, the Adige from the Ponte Nuovo (Dresden, 1747–48; only 1158 px); #11 Bellotto, Castelvecchio and Ponte Scaligero (1745–46). P3 alternative: #19/#20 Harding after Bonington, Corso Sant’Anastasia lithograph 1830 (street scene, portrait format). Skipped #18 (Schütze after Pezoldt, dated only 1835–60) and #17 (Guardi capriccio, not a Verona view). P4 alternatives: #21 general view along the Adige, #23 Ponte Pietra. #30 Joachim Lutz 1935 watercolor skipped as weak.
